intro.text: X is below S, for your left ring finger. The full stop sits below L, for your right ring finger.
intro.tip: A full stop is followed by a space – the space bar is always your thumb’s job.

steps.title: Meet X and full stop
steps.instructions: Press each key as it lights up. The cursor waits for the right key.

steps.title: Guided drill
steps.text: sxs l.l sxs l.l xxx ... six. box. fix. extra.
steps.instructions: Reach for the new keys, then return to the home row.

steps.title: Mix it up
steps.instructions: New keys mixed with the ones you already know.

steps.title: Real words
steps.instructions: Every word uses only keys you have learnt.

steps.title: Hands-on challenge
text: the fox jumped over six boxes. it was an exciting day. we fixed the axle. relax and type.
max packed an extra box. the expert explained it. we excitedly waited. the sky was clear.
steps.instructions: The keyboard hints fade out – trust your fingers!
